predictions.blurb: A brutal fall from No. 2 to No. 12 for Ohio State, but the computers haven't blinked — SP+ still has the Buckeyes first and FPI second. That gap between poll perception and model math makes them the most dangerous team outside the top 10.
Kentucky climbed from No. 9 to No. 6, but the models are deeply skeptical: 31st in SP+ and 26th in FPI. A trip to Tennessee will tell us which number is closer to the truth.
Notre Dame dropped from No. 5 to No. 11 while sitting No. 1 in FPI and No. 3 in SP+. Hosting No. 1 Miami as a favorite is the quickest route back up.
Wake Forest slid from No. 14 to No. 16 despite an FPI that likes them at 11th. SP+ is the dissenter at 25th, leaving the Demon Deacons a bit of a split decision.
Utah jumped from No. 6 to No. 3 while both models hold steady at 10th. The Holy War is the Utes' chance to prove the poll, not the computers, has it right.
